digest.component_or_area: CI reliability, code quality audit remediation (multi-component)
propositions: CI default-suite has a reliability flake in pytest-xdist worker teardown under load contention that produces benign false positives
User-facing assignee documentation example teaches an identity inconsistent with docs/config.md Jira resolution
File structured_run.py, compact.py, and event_append.py exceed 800 LOC cap due to mixed responsibilities and flat module structure without clear layer separation

Graph subsystem functions (_find_direct_blockers, _get_all_blocked_by, check_cycle_at_level, detect_newly_unblocked) have high cyclomatic complexity (>15) driven by duplicated BFS and loader infrastructure across four call-sites
attest package lacks complete type annotations required by mypy --disallow-untyped-defs
